_doc: "Ride there" (#1120, RideThere: src/creatures/ride_there.gd): E at a tied horse lists the places you know to ride to; one chosen, a fade, the clock on by the ride (the flat distance times `winding`, at `speed` from valley.json's speeds, plus `extra_s` to mount, tie up and go round), and you're stood by your horse at that place's hitching rail. A stand-in till riding's built (#478); the run speed is untouched (Sean, 2026-11-20). Each place: `id` (valley.json's places), `name` (as the list says it), `known` (any of: always; been, you've come within `been_m` of it; fact:KEY or fact:KEY=VALUE, a StoryState fact), and its hitch: on a town lot (`lot`, `along` m from its x0, `out` m off its front: minus is into the street) or on one of its roads (`road`, `back_m` m back along it from its end at the place, the rail `side_m` off the road's middle, + to the right going in).
